title: RightMotion Canonical Architecture Authority Map
description: Defines the authoritative single owner, consumers, forbidden override paths, and boundary rules for every major decision in RightMotion.

semantic_story_modeling.concept: Script Analysis, Core Idea, Narrative Segmentation, Causal Extraction
forbidden_overrides: Remotion Canvas must never re-parse script text to deduce semantic intent
Orchestrator must never alter semantic segments or claims determined by Frontier S
Thumbnail director must never re-invent core curiosity or emotional tension

visual_concept_translation.concept: Physical Metaphor Selection, Mechanism Choice, Transformation Modeling, Rejection Scoring
forbidden_overrides: Remotion components must not downgrade chosen mechanism to UI presentation cards
Orchestrator must respect championCandidate mechanism and required frontiers
Agent must not visualize elements explicitly marked in whatIsIntentionallyNotVisualized

capability_orchestration.concept: Frontier Capability Selection, Complexity Budget Enforcement, Intensity Allocation
forbidden_overrides: No script or component may reactivate dormant F3
Complexity budgets (2.5 hook, 4.5 logic, 3.0 solution) cannot be bypassed
F_UBG must not be pruned as a complexity effect

motion_specification_ast.concept: Physical Entity Definition, Geometry, Forces, State Mutations, World Memory
forbidden_overrides: Canvas.tsx must not invent actors or forces that violate ast.types.ts schema
No actor may have geometry type in BANNED_GEOMETRY_TYPES (card, panel, dashboard)
No mutation may occur without spoken-word temporal anchoring

spatial_geometry_resolution.concept: Mobile 9:16 Inset Safe Zones, Actor Bounds, Dead Space Elimination, Font Scale Floors
forbidden_overrides: No headline text below 56px, no body text below 36px
No interactive or hero content inside hazard zones y:[0, 230] or y:[1560, 1920]
Components must not define independent conflicting safe bounds

audio_synthesis_and_transcription.concept: Neural TTS Voice Synthesis, Pause Compression, Conversational Turns, Faster-Whisper Timestamps
forbidden_overrides: dialogue_engine.py is deprecated compatibility shim; no new audio logic permitted there
No script may synthesize audio without running word-level Whisper transcription
No audio may be played without corresponding transcript.json mapping

background_intelligence_and_selection.concept: Universal Background Asset Discovery, Computer Vision Analysis, Registry Indexing, Semantic Selection
forbidden_overrides: Specialized backgrounds (Finance/Health) must not be forced into universal background registry
Backgrounds must never be selected purely for decorative fill without semantic rationale
Assets must never be loaded from outside canonical directory (path traversal protected)

channel_routing_and_identities.concept: Channel Visual DNA, Colors, Persona Roles, Publishing Tags, Target Audience

self_improvement.palette: #f8fafc light canvas, #090d16 inky text, Judy presenter
self_improvement.presenter_mode: Judy bust (waist-up grounded) or solo mechanism

forbidden_overrides: Do not hardcode channel color matrices into Express route handlers (server.js)
Do not invent new routing tags without updating channels.json
Do not mix channel identities (e.g. Judy presenter on Apex Wealth)
channel_routing_and_identities.status: DUPLICATED (Target: Single Canonical Channel Store in config/channels.json)

clip_registration_and_manifest.concept: Project Inventory, Clip Metadata, Remotion Composition ID, Thumbnail Still Binding
forbidden_overrides: Python scripts must not textually mutate registry.ts using string replace
Root.tsx must not contain hardcoded clip compositions
render_all_thumbnails.js must not maintain a duplicate hardcoded map

thumbnail_intelligence_and_rendering.concept: Curiosity Gap Extraction, Hook Word Synthesis, Archetype Selection, Layout Generation
forbidden_overrides: Thumbnails must never display page numbers or PDF names
Thumbnails must never use banned patterns (pill badges, subtitle cards, explanatory paragraphs)
Text hooks must never exceed 3 words

anti_cardification_and_quality_audit.concept: Cardification Scoring, Primary Mechanism Ratio, Mute Test, Spoken-Word Coupling, Depth Audit
forbidden_overrides: Never approve a clip with Cardification Score >= 40.0
Never bypass the Mute Test or Remove-Text Test
Never permit PhysicalCard to serve as a general-purpose information container
anti_cardification_and_quality_audit.status: AUTHORITATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC (Target: AST-native inspection instead of regex)

render_pipeline_and_hardware_acceleratio.concept: Remotion Headless Execution, Concurrency, Hardware ANGLE GPU / SwiftShader Fallback, Notification
forbidden_overrides: Do not invoke remotion render directly without going through render_clip.py
Do not run CPU-only render if GPU is available unless explicitly requested
Do not exceed concurrency 4 on consumer GPU memory setups

studio_security_and_remote_access.concept: Local Owner Capability, Visitor Invite RBAC, Cloudflare Tunnel, Origin & Header Hardening
forbidden_overrides: Never treat a request with proxy headers as local owner
Never permit visitor sessions to access owner routes (channels, credentials, secrets)
Never bypass token verification when cloud tunnel is enabled

event_notifications.concept: System Alerts, Render Completions, Publishing Status, Studio UI Live Feed
forbidden_overrides: Do not write unvalidated schemas into notifications.json
Do not bypass notificationService when studio server is alive
event_notifications.status: CONCURRENT_WRITE_HAZARD (Target: Unified SQLite or Mutex Store)
